Sagittarius and Pisces compatibility

How Sagittarius (Dhanu) and Pisces (Meen) are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Fire and Water
Modes
Mutable (dwiswabhava), both
Ruling planets
Jupiter
Place in the zodiac
4/10 from each other
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
5 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
7 of 7 points
Sign-level view
Strongly supportive

Sagittarius horoscope · Pisces horoscope

The elements: Fire and Water

Sagittarius is Fire and Pisces is Water, the pairing the tradition calls steam: strong attraction, and strong reactions. Sagittarius is direct where Pisces is sensitive, so the work in this pair is in how things are said, not only what.

Temperament

Sagittarius and Pisces are both mutable (dwiswabhava) signs, the adaptable signs of the zodiac. They bend easily for each other, and the tradition's caution is the opposite of a clash: with both adapting, decisions can drift. Someone has to choose.

The ruling planets

Sagittarius and Pisces are both ruled by Jupiter. One ruling planet is the strongest form of Graha Maitri, the full 5 points: the two signs want things for the same deep reasons, even when they show it differently.

Their place in the zodiac

Counted from Sagittarius, Pisces is the fourth sign; counted from Pisces, Sagittarius is the tenth. In Bhakoot this is a 4/10 placement. It scores the full 7 points: the tradition sees the two signs as supporting each other's wellbeing and prosperity.

What each brings

Sagittarius is traditionally said to bring optimism, adventure, humour and frankness to a relationship, and to need freedom, space to grow and shared ideals. Pisces is said to bring compassion, romance and imagination, and to need gentleness, emotional understanding and kind boundaries. The pair does well when each gives what the other needs, rather than what they would want themselves.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Sagittarius and Pisces compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: strongly supportive. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 5 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 7 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Does it matter which partner is Sagittarius and which is Pisces?

Not for anything on this page: elements, temperament, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot read the same both ways. Some other kootas of Guna Milan, such as Varna and Vashya, do look at who is the bride and who is the groom.
